comparison_basis: The three exact PDFs supplied by the user, visually inspected as individual pages and measured from their PDF drawing paths.

observations.observation: One large product name, one complete product figure, generous white field; no editorial introduction.
observations.adaptation: Keep one finished ENTROPI model view on cover; retain only product/revision and prototype pointer.

observations.observation: Hardware is identified by actual form, nearby quantity and small exact part number. Quantities are 18 pt in extracted PDF text.
observations.adaptation: Use 18 pt quantities and20/30/10family IDs next to exact printed fasteners; avoid repeated explanatory paragraphs.

observations.observation: A small complete object is linked to two large local fastening details through continuous pointed callout tails.
observations.adaptation: Use connected tails and a smaller overview on the three lock pages, preserving actual joint targets.

observations.observation: Hardware overview feeds directly into local repeated counts. Fine approach axes show the relationship between moving hardware and its actual hole.
observations.adaptation: Keep the verified pin/wedge axes thin and dashed, with a separate bold motion arrow. Quantities and family IDs sit at the detail.

observations.observation: Two or three consecutive actions may share a page while camera and object orientation remain stable; the local outcome is shown at the insertion site.
observations.adaptation: Retain 17 pages; use actual seated lock details beside insertion stages and shorten repeated bottom text.

observations.observation: Part variants are precise; assembly then fastening is read in order on the same stable object. Adjacent detail comparisons explain an important choice locally.
observations.adaptation: Keep pin-before-wedge sequence; distinguish short camera wedges from long frame wedges, with optional frame choice and page jump before that step.

layout_risks: Connected tails must terminate at the correct actual joint and stay clear of captions; an intact circle plus a new tail would create a visual seam.
A 0.75 pt contour is appropriate for carrier/lock vectors; dense PCB details need lighter lines rather than a uniform increase across all imagery.
18 pt quantities and added family IDs must be checked against the two-detail layout at actual A4 size.
The seated lock detail must use the corresponding keeper/yoke/frame geometry; a generic lock result could be mechanically misleading.
The PCB insertion gate must stay before assembly; graphical simplification cannot imply a verified approach path.
source_artwork_policy: Independent ENTROPI CAD illustrations and existing fonts; reference PDF artwork and fonts are not copied.
